last_episode_to_air.name: Borrowed Time
last_episode_to_air.overview: Thomas and Diego are put in the back of a carriage and rode back to Las Tunas. Thomas asks why Pierre did it. He monologues about how the cycle of war and death only ends with pirates themselves, and as the war continued he realized, pirates no longer have a place in their world. Josiah eagerly waits for Duncan's return but he never does, leading him to go looking for him. Josiah finds Duncan under a tree unable to walk, groaning in pain. Josiah hugs Duncan, who cries "I couldn't save her", insisting to Josiah that it was supposed to be him the bullet hit. The two embrace each other and share one final laugh. Duncan tells Josiah to put him out his misery but Josiah refuses. Duncan places a British pistol in Josiah's hand, Josiah cries, screaming "I'm sorry" before shooting Duncan, killing him instantly. In the morning, Josiah gives Duncan a burial on the outskirts of the city, vowing revenge against Thomas, who now, alongside Diego is being taken to Britain for interrogation.

name: Tiedbound
overview: Thomas Navarro, a young pirate in the Caribbean has to navigate political annihilation of his father’s crew, the Black Hawkes, and rival crews while battling with the moral crossroads his father burdens him with.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Thomas Navarro, son of the ruthless Black Hawkes captain, Benjamin Navarro, struggles between the ongoing war between pirate factions, and the looming British threat, as well as the moral inheritance his father's lifestyle forces upon him.
